games.name: Ludo Arena! 🎲 [2-4 Players]
games.desc:
Ludo Arena is a fast, friendly board game for 2-4 players. Roll the dice,
move your pieces around the board, send your opponents back to start, and
be the first to bring all four pieces home.

No waiting around: jump straight into a match against smart bots, or
create a private room, share your code, and play with friends from any
server. Every match is quick, every roll matters.

🎲 HOW TO PLAY
Roll a six to leave your base. Move your pieces around the board.
Land on an opponent and send them back to the start. First player to
get all four pieces home wins.

👥 PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a private room, share the code, and your friends join you no matter
where they are. Invite friends directly from the menu in one tap.

🎨 COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Open chests to unlock new boards, dice and piece skins. Show them off at
the table — everyone sees what you're playing with.

⚡ BUILT TO BE QUICK
Matches are short enough for a break and good enough to run one more.
Runs smoothly on phone, tablet

• Roll, sprint, crouch, and outplay your opponents
• Collect unique weapon skins and effects
• Create or join a clan and compete with others
• Climb the leaderboards and earn rewards
• Frequent events, giveaways, and new content

🏆 Progress

games.name: Project Lazarus: 💀 ZOMBIES 💀
games.desc:
Survive the endless waves of zombie hordes in this cooperative shooter. Earn points by killing zombies and repairing barricades. Get better weapons and open up new areas before the undead overrun you.

Project Lazarus: Zombies is the spiritual successor to my old zombies game. Inspired by classic wave-based Call of Duty Zombies.

Controls:
Interact - [F] / Hold [Button X]
Fire - [Left Mouse Button] / [Right Trigger]
Aim Down Sights - [Q] / [Right Mouse Button] / [Left Trigger]
Reload - [R] / [Button X]
Switch Weapon - [1], [2], [3], [Scroll Wheel] / [Button Y], [Button B]
Sprint - Hold [Left Shift] / [Left Stick Button]
Knife - [V] / [Right Stick Button]
Inspect - [B] / [DPad Left]
Settings - [P] / [DPad Down]
Scoreboard - [Tab] / [DPad Right]

🎮 Available on Desktop, Phones, Tablets, Xbox, & PlayStation.
❤️ Like, Favorite, and Follow the game to receive notifications when I update the game!
⚠️ Exploiters will be permanently banned.
